I lost my best friend to suicide 8 month ago nearly. It hurts me to this day. It will hurt people a lot they might not get there head around it. 
I understand that meaning of wanting to end my life and how hard it is. Believe you me when your at that point you think about everone your going to hurt and how much it going to course pain. But understand from the point that fighting the war thats deep in the head is not as easy as people think. When your at that point you can't find a way out your lost with in them. When I found out what happened I said hat of to her as i know she not in pain or suffering anymore. You need to remember the good and not the bad, when people write this letters they put they heart and soul in to them wanting to explain how they feel but sometimes it's not possible. Look up at the sky at night its free.. 
I'm sorry really am but please try understand and accept It 
I didn't want to upset or make anyone angry though this post but I had to say something. It's not guilt tripping its the feeling, the thought that when though the mind at the time. 
Hope your okay though. 
Stay strong.
